title: Warming Contrast Media for Hysterosalpingography
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare the use of warm-media with cold-media in performing hysterosalpingography (HSG).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* infertile women who seeking for HSG testing

Exclusion Criteria:

* suspect of pregnancy
* acute low reproductive duct infection
* a known hypersensitivity to iodine
* genital bleeding
* genital malignancy
